mapper.select: select id, del_flag as delFlag from cms_topic where id=#{topicId} for update
select id, topic_id as topicId, slot, entity_type as entityType, entity_id as entityId, status from product_role where topic_id=#{topicId} and slot='CONTENT' and status=1 order by id for update

mapper.sql: id, snapshot_id as snapshotId, topic_id as topicId, member_id as memberId, request_id as requestId, audit_task_id as auditTaskId, source_config_version as sourceConfigVersion, content_hash as contentHash
